source: clinical operating point: 'likely' >= 0.50 for every finding, 0.30-0.50 = 'Possible - needs review', < 0.30 hidden. Preprocessing 'none' chosen on DENTEX validation (macro-F1 0.605 vs 0.549 with CLAHE).

calibrated_f1_optimal.note: F1-optimal on 50 validation X-rays; caries 0.20 maximises F1 but calls many low-confidence boxes 'likely', so the clinical point above is used. See results/v2/CALIBRATION.md.
